About This Tool

Use this tool to view all the relevant data stuctures for a query and the data processing pipeline.

It runs on your active query definitions, so first setup your cohort, results table, etc. in the UI and then come here to view how it is run.

  • COHORT COUNT
    The query that counts the number of subjects in your cohort based on the active cohort_def.
  • RESULTS TABLE
    The query that creates the results table based on the active cohort_def and active table_def.
  • ANALYSIS OUTPUT
    The query that creates the analysis output based on the active cohort_def and active analysis_def. This is only relevant on sites where chiron_settings.CHIRON_SHOW_ANALYSIS_VIEW=True
